name: traphouse-kitchen
description: Restaurant web application for menu management and customer ordering

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.verify: npm run repo:where-migrate-deploy && cd backend && npm run prisma:fix-migrations-dir && npm run test:all
